mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly negative at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to raise rates and depressing equity valuations over the following 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods, or the mechanism fails when inflation is already high.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for two consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production and economic momentum, which correlates with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-mo MA - 3% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the correlation between INDPRO weakness and equity declines breaks down.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both GDPC1 and HOUST above their respective 6-month moving averages signals strengthening housing and overall demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 6-mo MA and HOUST > 6-mo MA simultaneously
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly positive during co-activation of both proxies, or the effect reverses in a high-inflation regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in FEDFUNDS below 2% while CPIAUCSL is rising above 3% YoY signals a policy-lag environment where monetary easing is insufficient to offset inflation, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly negative during co-activation, or the mechanism fails when inflation expectations fall.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average by more than 1% for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 12-mo MA + 1% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods, or the effect reverses during wage-price spirals.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in RSAFS below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening consumer savings and spending capacity, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 12-mo MA for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods, or the mechanism fails during periods of strong fiscal stimulus.
